map.风速 10 m/s → 落在 8.0–10.7 区间=5 级（清风），小树摇摆；: Wind speed 10 m/s → falls in the 8.0-10.7 range = force 5 (fresh breeze), small trees sway; 20 m/s → 17.2-20.7 = force 8 (gale), twigs break off; 25 m/s → 24.5-28.4 = force 10 (storm).
map.「海面白沫成条、渔船缩帆」对应 8 级，反推风速约 17–20 m/s，与测风一: "Sea foam in streaks, fishing boats reefing sails" corresponds to force 8, back-calculating to a wind speed of about 17-20 m/s, consistent with the anemometer.
map.≥32.7 m/s 为 12 级（飓风/台风级），对应陆地罕见、破坏极大。: ≥32.7 m/s is force 12 (hurricane/typhoon level), rare over land with extreme damage.
map.最初为海面设计，后扩到陆地现象描述；现代多用 m/s 定量，风级作通俗对照。: It was originally designed for the sea and later extended to land phenomena; modern practice mostly uses m/s quantitatively, with the wind force as a popular reference.
